decisions.relation: Rows become "controls" assertions: Cliopatria maps the territory each polity held and does not separate control from legal sovereignty (maintainer decision, 2026-09-27). Each assertion says so in its notes.
decisions.rows: Only POLITY rows are imported. Grouping rows (a name in parentheses with a Components list, such as "(British Empire)") are skipped, because the rows they group already cover their land. RELATION rows are skipped too, and counted.
decisions.subjects: Assertions name Cliopatria's own polities (cliopatria-<name>), with records in polities/ that stay in this folder. They are not matched to our polities by Wikidata ID, because some of Cliopatria's IDs are wrong for this period: its "Republic of China" rows carry Q148 (the People's Republic of China) and its "Republic of Korea" row carries Q423 (North Korea). The hand-written polity-crosswalk.yaml links them to our polities, and says on what evidence.
decisions.dates: FromYear and ToYear are whole years, inclusive (per Cliopatria's README). The start is FromYear, with year precision; the end is ToYear + 1, the first year the row no longer applied. A row that runs to the last year in the data is imported as "ongoing".
decisions.bce: Cliopatria's README says negative years are BCE, but not whether year 0 exists. Its data has one: six rows end in year 0, and each is followed by a row of the same polity starting in year 1 (checked 2026-09-28). So its years are read as astronomical, as EDTF's are: -40 is 41 BCE. IDs use the BCE year a reader sees (…-41bce).
decisions.geometry: Each ring is simplified (Douglas–Peucker, 0.005°), trimmed to the import area, and rounded to 4 decimal places. Edge precision is "unknown". Cliopatria's own area (km², equal-area projection) is kept in each shape's properties.
decisions.puppet_states: Cliopatria folds some governments into their patrons (for example, there is no separate Manchukuo; its land is inside the Empire of Japan). That is Cliopatria's view, shown attributed, not an error to correct.
decisions.selection: POLITY rows that overlap the years -4000 to 2100 (astronomical; that is every row) and have land in the import area after trimming.
decisions.ids: Each row's ID is <unit>-<first year>, with four digits from 1 CE and <n>bce before that; when two rows share a name and a first year, the later one (in the file's order) gets -2 (Phase 5 decision 12).
